notes: New: find an address. Click the magnifying glass at the top right, type an address, a town or a landmark and press Enter: the map goes there and puts a pin on it, ready to plan a flight
The search box only opens when you click the magnifying glass, so it takes no room on the map. The pin lets clicks through, so you can put a waypoint right on it
With Azure Maps, the addresses come from Azure (your key stays on the server); with the other maps, from OpenStreetMap
